faq.question: Do I need design experience to take the course?
faq.answer: No, the course is designed for beginners and professionals. We start with the basics and gradually move to advanced topics.

faq.question: How much time should I dedicate to the course each week?
faq.answer: It is recommended to dedicate 5-7 hours per week for optimal course completion in 6-8 weeks.

faq.question: Can I pay for the course in installments?
faq.answer: Yes, we provide the option to pay in installments through our partners. Details in chat with the bot.

faq.question: Will I get access to course updates after completion?
faq.answer: Yes, all updates and new materials will be available to you free of charge within your pricing plan.

services.title: Services
services.subtitle: What we offer
services.design_desc: Development of presentations, advertising banners, corporate style and visual content for business, social media and marketing.
services.websites_desc: Creating modern websites, landing pages and corporate portals. Responsive design, optimization and support.
services.printing_desc: Business cards, flyers, brochures, invitations. Full cycle: design + printing + delivery across Ukraine.

services-detail.cta_text: Ready to start? Fill out the brief or contact us.

portfolio_description_1: TechCorp approached us with the task of creating a corporate presentation that would reflect their innovative approach to technology and help them stand out at an international conference. The presentation needed to combine technical accuracy with visual appeal to engage both technical specialists and business executives.
portfolio_challenge_1: The main challenge was to present complex technical information in an accessible and visually engaging way, while maintaining a professional corporate aesthetic that would appeal to an international audience.
portfolio_solution_1: We developed a modern presentation with clean lines, sophisticated data visualizations, and a color palette that reflected TechCorp's brand identity. We used infographics to simplify complex concepts and created a narrative flow that guided the audience through the company's technological advantages.
portfolio_results_1: The presentation received excellent feedback at the conference, helping TechCorp secure several new partnerships. The client reported increased engagement during their session and praised the presentation's ability to make technical content accessible to diverse audiences.
portfolio_description_2: For an Instagram advertising campaign, we created a series of eye-catching banners designed to stop scrollers and communicate the brand's message instantly. The banners needed to be optimized for mobile viewing while maintaining brand consistency across different ad sets.
portfolio_challenge_2: Creating banners that would stand out in the crowded Instagram feed while adhering to the platform's specific technical requirements and maintaining brand consistency across multiple ad variations.
portfolio_solution_2: We designed a banner series with bold typography, vibrant colors, and clear focal points that would be visible even on small mobile screens. Each banner was optimized for Instagram's specifications and included clear calls-to-action tailored to different stages of the marketing funnel.
portfolio_results_2: The banner campaign achieved a 35% higher click-through rate compared to industry averages and significantly increased brand engagement. The client reported that the banners performed exceptionally well in A/B testing against their previous creative assets.
portfolio_description_3: We created a complete set of business cards for a beauty salon that needed to convey elegance and professionalism while being practical for daily use. The design needed to reflect the salon's premium positioning while remaining functional.
portfolio_challenge_3: Balancing luxurious aesthetics with practical considerations for a business card that would be handled frequently. The design needed to work well at small scale while conveying the salon's premium services.
portfolio_solution_3: We selected premium matte paper with subtle texture and created a minimalist design with elegant typography and a distinctive color scheme. The cards featured spot UV coating on the logo for a tactile element that enhanced the premium feel.
portfolio_results_3: The business cards received positive feedback from both the salon staff and their clients. The salon reported that the cards helped reinforce their premium positioning and were frequently complimented by clients during visits.
portfolio_description_4: EcoFuture, an environmentally focused startup, needed a presentation to communicate their innovative sustainability solutions to potential investors. The presentation needed to balance scientific data with inspirational storytelling to attract funding.
portfolio_challenge_4: Presenting complex environmental data and business projections in a way that was both scientifically accurate and emotionally compelling to attract investor interest.
portfolio_solution_4: We created a presentation that combined clear data visualizations with powerful imagery and a compelling narrative about environmental stewardship. The design used earth tones and natural textures to reinforce the company's mission while maintaining a professional appearance suitable for investor meetings.
portfolio_results_4: The presentation helped EcoFuture secure their seed funding round, with investors specifically commenting on the quality of the presentation materials. The client noted that the presentation made complex concepts accessible to investors without scientific backgrounds.
portfolio_description_5: For a client launching a new product line, we created a coordinated set of business cards and flyers that needed to work together as a cohesive brand identity system while serving different promotional purposes.
portfolio_challenge_5: Creating a unified brand identity across different print formats with varying sizes and purposes, while ensuring each piece was optimized for its specific use case.
portfolio_solution_5: We developed a cohesive visual system with consistent typography, color palette, and design elements that adapted appropriately to each format. The business cards focused on essential contact information with a premium feel, while the flyers provided space for product details and promotional messaging.
portfolio_results_5: The coordinated print materials helped Artisan Goods Co. create a strong first impression at trade shows and in client meetings. The client reported that the unified brand identity made their marketing materials more memorable and professional.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything about work, ordering and learning
faq.how_order_a: You can leave a request through the form on the site, write in Telegram or fill out the brief with our bot. We discuss the task, deadlines and cost, after which we start work. Prepayment 50%.
faq.payment_a: We work with 50% prepayment. Payment is accepted by card (Visa/MasterCard), bank transfer or cryptocurrency by agreement. The remaining 50% — after approval of the layout.
faq.timing_a: Presentation — from 3 to 7 days. Website-landing page — from 7 to 14 days. Corporate style — from 5 to 10 days. Printing — from 2 to 5 days. Exact terms depend on complexity and are discussed individually.
faq.revisions_a: The price includes up to 2 rounds of revisions. Additional revisions are discussed separately. We always strive to make sure you are satisfied with the result.
faq.course_format_a: The course is fully online. You get access to video lessons, text content and additional materials on the platform. Study at your own pace — access to materials opens gradually.
faq.duration_q: How much time is needed for the course?
faq.duration_a: The course is designed for 4-6 weeks with regular classes of 2-3 hours per week. But you can go faster or slower — there are no time limits within your tariff.
faq.tools_q: What programs are needed for the course?
faq.tools_a: For most lessons, PowerPoint or Google Slides is sufficient. A separate module is dedicated to Figma — it is free. All links and resources are provided in the course.
faq.support_a: Yes! All students have access to the Telegram chat. The «VIP» tariff includes priority support with personal guidance.
faq.printing_a: Yes, we offer print design: business cards, flyers, brochures, banners, invitations, stickers. Terms and prices depend on layout complexity and circulation.
faq.refund_a: For design services: if work hasn't started — 100% refund. If the layout has been approved — refund is not possible. For the course: if after the first three lessons the course doesn't suit you — we refund the full cost within 14 days.
